why: A new object holding objects the caller holds, handed to a call that may write or keep it (design/w1g-opaque-handed.md; translate.mjs mixedTree). Every part sits at a key the text fixes (no spread, no computed or repeated key), so the handed value holds each part's value at its path; an existing part (a member read, a parameter, an outside answer) is named by its value, as when it is handed alone, and a new part written in place (a literal, a copy call, new) is held by no other name. The handed term is handed_fresh_<skeleton>_<T>(v, k): the skeleton is the literal's shape with each existing part written E, so a new part and an existing part of equal value are two terms. Before, every unit here was refused copied-argument (a new object holding objects). (a) report: the literal unchanged, the count computed another way outside it: proved, listed as an opaque step. (b) swapped: the two existing parts swapped: not proved, witnessed. (c) planted: a boundary constant inside (1 to 2): not proved, witnessed. (d) shared: one array in two slots against the array and structuredClone of it (equal values, a callee can tell them apart by identity): not proved, witnessed; LEAN_BREAK=handed-skeleton drops the skeleton from the term and proves it (a false proof).
